concern: Urdu ساعتوں (plural of ساعت, "hours") is romanised "saaton", which reads as ساتوں ("all seven", e.g. saaton din/saaton aasman) -- the same family of collision ADR 0005 R5 already resolved for the singular by spelling ساعت as "saa-at" rather than plain "saat".
suggestion: Din ke donon siron mein namaz barpa rakh aur raat ki kayi saa-aton mein bhi, yaqeenan nekiyan buraiyon ko door kar deti hain. Yeh naseehat hai naseehat pakadne walon ke liye.
